findings.title: PR description incorrectly claims every new test fails on pristine code
findings.claim: The PR description says 'Every new test fails against pristine marshal.go/helpers.go', but TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads, TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType, and the 'concrete slice'/'resolvable element type' subtests of the no-Go-type test all still pass on the old code, so the description should distinguish regression guards from tests that actually fail before the fix.

findings.title: Allocation-based test can fail spuriously due to unrelated goroutine allocations
findings.claim: TestUnmarshalVectorRejectsNestedCountBeforeAllocating compares process-wide runtime.MemStats.TotalAlloc against a 128 KB limit, and goroutines from other tests in the package can allocate during measurement and push it over that limit; testing.AllocsPerRun or a looser limit would be more reliable, though the large margin (~25MB vs ~3.5KB) makes a false failure unlikely.

findings.title: New length check changes error message for non-pointer/wrong-typed destinations before…
findings.claim: The new check runs before the destination type is checked, so a short payload scanned into a non-pointer or wrong-typed destination now returns 'N dimensions do not fit in M bytes' instead of 'can not unmarshal into non-pointer ...'; this second error-message change isn't mentioned in the PR description, though it's harmless.
